items.title: Even mid-sprint to a secret flight, the Navy's tech chief has a pitch for investors
items.summary: Navy CTO Justin Fanelli talks co-investing alongside VCs instead of funding early research himself, recent buys like a $562 million autonomous refueling deal, and the Navy's updated wish list — from AI to quantum — for where founders should be building next.
items.titleZh: 即使在秘密飞行的冲刺中，海军技术主管也会向投资者推销
items.summaryZh: 海军首席技术官贾斯汀·法内利（Justin Fanelli）与风险投资公司共同投资，而不是自己资助早期研究，最近购买了5.62亿美元的自动加油协议，以及海军更新的愿望清单——从人工智能到量子——创始人下一步应该在哪里建设。

items.title: Kara Swisher: AI Isn’t Going to Destroy Humanity—But the People Building It Might
items.summary: The longtime tech journalist says she’s seen Silicon Valley make the same mistakes again and again.
items.titleZh: 卡拉·斯威舍：人工智能不会毁灭人类，但建造它的人可能会
items.summaryZh: 这位资深科技记者说，她看到硅谷一次又一次地犯同样的错误。

items.title: As AI companies get closer to ‘recursive self-improvement,’ this physics professor calls full autonomy ‘the worst idea in the history of humanity’
items.summary: The prospect of artificial intelligence models teaching themselves autonomously to be more efficient and capable appears ever closer to reality.
items.titleZh: 随着人工智能公司越来越接近“递归自我完善”，这位物理学教授称完全自主是“人类历史上最糟糕的想法”
items.summaryZh: 人工智能模型自主学习以提高效率和能力的前景似乎越来越接近现实。

items.title: Climate XChange is giving away more EVs than ever before in its 11th Annual EV Raffle
items.summary:
What would you choose with up to $120,000 to spend on a fully customized EV – a Lucid Air, Rivian R1S, Porsche Macan Electric, BMW i7, or perhaps two EVs instead of one?



 more…
items.titleZh: Climate XChange在其第11届年度电动汽车抽奖活动中赠送了比以往任何时候都多的电动汽车
items.summaryZh: 你会选择花费高达12万美元购买一辆完全定制的电动汽车——Lucid Air、Rivian R1S、保时捷Macan Electric、宝马i7，或者两辆电动汽车而不是一辆？

items.title: Vals, backed by Andreessen Horowitz, is looking to become the gold standard for AI benchmarking
items.summary: Vals AI is hoping to make AI benchmarking a more neutral and trustworthy resource in a world increasingly inundated by AI models.
items.titleZh: 由Andreessen Horowitz支持的Vals正寻求成为人工智能基准测试的黄金标准
items.summaryZh: Vals AI希望在人工智能模型日益泛滥的世界中，使人工智能基准测试成为一种更中立、更值得信赖的资源。

items.title: The AI kill switch, explained: 'It's not too little, but it's probably too late'
items.summary: As runaway AI fears reach a crescendo, policymakers and tech leaders are weighing the effectiveness of a magic AI stop button known as a kill switch.
items.titleZh: AI终止开关解释说：“这不是太少，但可能为时已晚”
items.summaryZh: 随着对人工智能失控的担忧愈演愈烈，政策制定者和技术领导者正在权衡一个被称为“死亡开关”的神奇人工智能停止按钮的有效性。

items.title: Join the WIRED World Fair in Miami on November 4
items.summary: For one day only, WIRED is bringing the technologies, people, and cultural forces transforming our world off the page and into real life.
items.titleZh: 参加11月4日在迈阿密举行的《连线》世界博览会
items.summaryZh: 仅仅一天，《连线》将改变我们世界的技术、人员和文化力量从纸上带到了现实生活中。

items.title: The Gates Foundation is spending $400 million on AI in schools. Teachers warn it could ‘end up widening’ the divide it’s meant to close
items.summary: “AI can support teacher expertise, but it cannot replace it,” one educator told Fortune.
items.titleZh: 盖茨基金会正在为学校的人工智能项目投入4亿美元。教师们警告说，这可能会“最终扩大”它本应缩小的差距
items.summaryZh: 一位教育工作者告诉《财富》杂志：“人工智能可以支持教师的专业知识，但不能取代它。”。

items.title: Scale AI and Passes founder Lucy Guo says AI is making people work harder, not less: ‘I worked a 26-hour day’
items.summary: Guo was the world’s youngest self-made woman billionaire before being surpassed by Kalshi cofounder Luana Lopes Lara.
items.titleZh: Scale AI和Passes创始人Lucy Guo表示，人工智能让人们工作更努力，而不是更少：“我每天工作26小时”
items.summaryZh: 郭是世界上最年轻的白手起家的女性亿万富翁，之后被Kalshi联合创始人Luana Lopes Lara超越。
